decomposition.title: Pokémon Chess
decomposition.premise: A strategic game combining the classic rules of chess with the unique abilities and personalities of Pokémon creatures. Players command Pokémon-themed chess pieces, each with special moves inspired by their species.

mechanics.description: Move chess pieces according to standard chess rules on the board.
Each Pokemon chess piece has unique abilities that modify moves or attacks beyond standard chess moves.
Players alternate turns moving one piece or activating abilities, following turn-based gameplay.
Win by placing the opponent's king piece in checkmate, following chess rules.

spaces.description: A standard 8x8 chessboard with positions for all chess pieces.

core.theme: battle of Pokemon chess pieces using chess strategy

mashup.why: Chess's turn-based movement integrates with Pokemon abilities to create a hybrid board strategy game.
